Legs.Subject: The floor-reciprocal division that the 64-bit quotient-counting word and the hard-leaf driver's per-segment bounds share, for positive ulong divisors: powers of two and their neighbours, hard-leaf segment endpoints, 1e19 and ulong.MaxValue; dividends at ulong magnitude anchors including 1e19 and the carrier top, around exact multiples of the anchor quotients and on a 256-step fixed walk per divisor. The reciprocal is FloorReciprocal(d)=floor(ulong.MaxValue/d), including d=1.
Legs.Against: Unsigned hardware division of the same dividend by the same divisor, sharing no reciprocal, high product or remainder correction.
Legs.Citation: ENVELOPE: the finite operand basis checks both quotient transitions and high magnitudes. The integer argument beside DivideByFloorReciprocal covers every n<2^64 and 0<d<2^64: the high-product estimate is floor(n/d) or one low, and its nonoverflowing remainder requires at most one correction.
